purpose: Keep AFK work lifecycle truth on a stable issue, ticket, or repository work item while treating branches, worktrees, pull requests, commits, checks, reviews, and merges as execution-attempt evidence.

rules: The work item owns lifecycle state; an execution artifact never becomes the work identity.
A work item may survive multiple branches, worktrees, pull requests, commits, reviews, failed attempts, or retries.
Closing or merging an execution artifact does not close the work item unless the DONE gate is independently satisfied.
In a GitHub-backed repository, use an issue anchor for new substantial work when issue mutation is available; ledger anchors remain valid for legacy/local-only continuity.

afk_states.meaning: The work item is sufficiently specified, dependencies are satisfied, and an autonomous agent may claim it without asking the operator to reconstruct intent.
One concrete executor owns the current mutation attempt; the work item remains the lifecycle anchor.
Implementation evidence exists and validation/proof must continue.
Validation evidence exists and review, critique, or repair remains.
The exact candidate is ready for integration or an integration gate remains; a PR may be evidence for this state but is not the state owner.
Progress requires an explicitly human-controlled credential, approval, protected runtime, or other operator-only action.
A concrete dependency, collision, external failure, or forbidden boundary prevents the next transition.
The whole work-item acceptance gate is satisfied, durable validation/acceptance proof and durable merge integration proof exist, Gate is none, and no safe actionable work remains.

transition_rules: READY may transition to CLAIMED only with a concrete executor and executable next action.
CLAIMED may advance through VERIFY, REVIEW, and MERGE as evidence strengthens; attempts may be replaced without changing work-item identity.
BLOCKED and OPERATOR preserve the same work-item identity and exact gate until the dependency changes.
DONE is a work-item conclusion, not a pull-request conclusion.
proof_ceiling: Static repository coordination semantics only. This contract proves issue/ticket-versus-execution-evidence separation, AFK state meaning, gate-state consistency, and durable proof-shape requirements. It does not prove that Acceptance gate prose is semantically satisfied, a live scheduler exists, GitHub Projects is configured, autonomous dispatch occurred, or external runtime behavior succeeded.

ready_gate.unresolved_dependency_rule: Any unresolved dependency or operator-only prerequisite must be represented by a non-none Gate and a BLOCKED or OPERATOR state rather than READY.
